aud: Exports to the US rose from A$41.0bn to A$60.0bn in 2025, and A$12.4bn of the rise was non-monetary gold. The US surplus was A$38.5bn, or A$52.5bn excluding gold.
usd: Exports to the US rose from US$27.1bn to US$38.7bn in 2025, and US$8.0bn of the rise was non-monetary gold. The US surplus was US$24.8bn, or US$33.9bn excluding gold.
